name: PageLayout
purpose: Initial library choices for collection, detail, settings, and dashboard pages. PageHeader owns the heading and actions. PageLayout adds transparent region wrappers without page padding or child styling. ReadingColumn provides 55ch/65ch/75ch starting measures. ContentGrid uses a container-responsive maximum of one to four columns. Products can propose additional recipes through review.
